user_decision: Explicit health evolution rather than exponential history discounting; deployment history remains SRAM-only.
scope: Architecture decision only. No new model, inference, compressor, aging rates or uncertainty calibration implemented.
principle: Old observations constrain past physical/health states. Their implications for current health pass through an explicit transition model and its uncertainty; age alone does not multiply their likelihood by a discount.

fast: SOC or explicitly defined stored-charge state
states.static_or_unresolved: Preserve supported calibration/model quantities and nuisance uncertainty; do not make all16parameters independently drift by default.

transition_template.notation: h_next = h_now + m(h_now, actual_elapsed, declared_exposures) + w
transition_template.mean_increment: Declared aging model, including a zero-mean drift alternative if no justified mean-rate law is available. Model assumptions must not be described as observed degradation.
transition_template.uncertainty: Declared transition distribution or bounded uncertainty, with units and scaling tied to actual elapsed time/exposures. Must be specified and validated, not tuned to conceal compressed-history error.
transition_template.exposures: Calendar time and charge throughput are available from actual intervals/current. Temperature dependence requires an explicit usable temperature model; current25C fixture is not temperature validation.
transition_template.measurement_correction: Only supported by informative new observations; retain weak/unresolved health modes otherwise.

evidence_contract: Original public prior once. Each observation and each transition factor owned once.
Past health can differ from current health; do not force old residuals to use current capacity/resistance.
Compressed summary must retain relevant current-state/health/nuisance correlations and declared approximation limits.
If retained observations are replayed, replace their summarized contribution or exclude them from the summary; never add both.
Declare whether eliminated histories are marginalized probabilistically or profiled; do not interchange those objectives.
No silent exponential discount, evidence deletion or certainty increase on eviction.
Select summary contents for faithful current-state inference under the transition model; stimulus still determines estimability.
physical_contract_required: Define stored-charge/SOC convention and how capacity loss changes charge inventory and SOC. Do not divide lifetime accumulated charge by today's capacity.
Preserve actual sample order, intervals and carried RC/hysteresis state across health boundaries.
Separate aging hypotheses from temperature, load dependence, sensor bias and model mismatch; do not force every voltage residual into health drift.
Define support failure/recovery and abrupt-change status before general trajectories.
compressor_implication: Use time-indexed state/health summaries linked by transition factors. Fixed response bases and multiple local summaries remain possible components; one static all-lifetime16parameter factor is not the aging target.
validation_before_compression: Zero-evolution case retains evidence and agrees with corresponding stationary reference under matched inference semantics.
Weak-input aging case propagates declared uncertainty; it must not report unsupported precise health corrections.
Synthetic gradual change followed by renewed excitation assesses tracking and correction without truth entering fit.
Temperature/mismatch/control cases assess false attribution to permanent aging.
Aging-aware full-history desktop reference and compressed candidate must use the same transition law, prior and inference semantics. Existing stationary545point comparison cannot validate aging.
Retain0.1NLL finite contrast criterion where applicable, but predeclare aging-state query geometry and factor ownership rather than silently recycling the static stencil.
open_contract_items: health transition mean and uncertainty family/scales
bounded-memory summary domains and saturation behavior
next_action: Specify and qualify a minimal aging-aware desktop reference contract before selecting the final history-compressor representation. Preserve stationary baseline as a zero-drift/reference control.
